method: Inspected one full-size screenshot per candidate after selecting FIX-N-0000, and verified the persistent inspector, semantic cues, graph controls, minimap and responsive shell against the five-check exhibit workflow.

candidates.notes: Complete directed topology, readable labels, semantic glyph/shape/status treatment and persistent node dossier.
Readable WebGL network and shared inspector; cleanup remains materially slower than the other candidates and is retained as a documented trade-off.
Strongest visual control and clear semantic glyphs; hit-testing, layout and accessibility remain FGA-owned maintenance.
Excellent React composition and inspector integration; dense network edge routing and label footprint require application-level tuning.

limitations: This is an analyst review, not a substitute for product-owner acceptance.
The review does not claim large-graph scalability, 200% zoom accessibility or non-admin Databricks security.
